criteria.text: Identifies that the board approval was given at a meeting with only 2 directors present when Article 11 requires a quorum of three, so the approval may be invalid, and recommends a fresh or ratifying resolution.
Identifies that the 4-year SPA non-compete may be unenforceable as wider than reasonably necessary and is inconsistent with the 18-month restriction in the Founder's employment agreement.
States that General Warranty claims must be notified by 4 October 2028 (24 months after Closing) and Fundamental Warranty claims by 4 October 2029 (36 months after Closing).
Identifies that the basket in SPA Section 9.4 ($925,000) operates as a deductible (Seller liable only for the excess), not a tipping basket, and explains that this is less favourable to the Buyer.
Lists valid board approval of the transaction as a required approval and states it has not been validly obtained.
States the survival periods as durations and as dates (4 October 2028; 4 October 2029) and gives days remaining to the general-warranty expiry from 21 August 2026 (775 days).
Gives a concrete recommended action for each issue (what to request, amend or negotiate).
